name: Art methods
summary: Pick the method by the job: real screenshots, an HTML template, or a generated image; then the image checks.

nodes.title: A job needs art
nodes.body:
- Reuse before making anything new: look in the art folder first.
- Product posts use real material; generated art only supports.

nodes.title: What is it for?
nodes.body:
- **product post:** real screenshots.
- **banner or card:** an HTML template rendered by Chrome.
- **background or key art:** a generated image.

nodes.title: Real screenshots
nodes.body: Use the screenshots folder; never a generated imitation of the app.

nodes.title: Generate the image
nodes.sub: Codex image generation, prompt saved beside it
nodes.body:
- `python media/image_gen.py "PROMPT" out.png --aspect 16:9`.
- Prompts in ASCII; no text, logos or real people in the image: add text in code.

nodes.title: Check the quota first
nodes.body: `python media/quota.py` reads the weekly Codex limit; exit 1 means no batch generation.

nodes.title: Image checks
nodes.body: Look at the result at full size before it goes anywhere.
checks: Text is spelled right and inside the safe area
No warped hands, faces or logos
Right size and under the platform's file limit

nodes.title: Art filed
nodes.sub: Saved with its prompt or source
